pull_request.title: Infrastructure: migrate calorimeter software and external tool adapters
pull_request.head: codex/software-calorimeter
pull_request.body:
Fourth migration step, based on #79 and ADR-008. Moves the prepared calorimeter reconstruction, FastJet and EDM4hep hit/cluster/jet persistence out of the ACTS fork. Pure helpers live in software/source/Calorimeter, transient data in software/source/EDM, and framework algorithms/converters in software/source/ActsExamples/Calorimeter. Python steering and output inspection live in software/running and software/analysis. Existing IdRes and nodehammer build/display adapters are moved to software/source/externals, with compatibility links from their old tools paths.

The source is pinned by provenance to ACTS fork 8adca5eec180515a23d58d132a1e17e317a59e67. All 40 C++/header files, including retained controls, are byte-identical to that revision. Local CMake paths, ownership, Make targets and documentation are adapted. FastJet, EDM4hep and podio remain from the existing Spack CI dependency installation; the ACTS submodule stays pristine.

Validation: all migrated libraries/examples built; 10/10 retained calorimeter C++ and pipeline controls passed, covering digitization, clustering, jets, input/output conversion, persistent relations and metadata. Six standalone header targets compiled 13 translation units. The Python-steered EDM4hep jet example passed; input/output ROOT files each contain three event entries and one metadata entry. The optional native nodehammer build passed all 602 upstream tests; relocated external glue passed 13 nodehammer and four IdRes controls. The repository node registry now matches reverified current setup/lock fingerprints. Session/project/token validators, source ownership checks and token preview passed. Earlier stack checks retain 10/10 detector tests, 10/10 local adapter/sensitivity tests, 128-track navigation, zero-error native/Gen3 comparison, and all 22 IdRes runs.

make software-test also runs geometry-test: fresh 128-track navigation followed by the independent native frame/bounds/material audit, so an ACTS gitlink update exercises that compatibility boundary. The original synthetic/prototype response contracts and limitations remain. This source-ownership refactor changes no detector parameter, calibration or accepted reference output. Merge in order: #77, #78, #79, then this PR.
